description: Query the current ICA state for a compiler from the PE primary (GET /puppet-ca/v1/intermediate-ca/:fqdn). Runs on the primary. Returns {"state": "none"} when no ICA request has ever been made for the compiler. Used by peadm::promote_compiler_to_ica's preflight step (ticket 7.6).

compiler_fqdn.description: Certname/FQDN of the compiler whose ICA state to query.
